mapper.sql: t.*, c.name AS customer_name, ct.name AS contact_name, ct.phone AS contact_phone, a.nickname AS assignee_name, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, CASE WHEN t.status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING') AND t.due_time < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue

FROM crm_ticket t JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = t.customer_id LEFT JOIN crm_contact ct ON ct.id = t.contact_id LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = t.material_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT l.material_id AS "materialId", m.code AS "materialCode", m.name AS "materialName", t.doc_no AS "docNo", CAST(t.biz_date AS CHAR(10)) AS "bizDate", t.partner_id AS "customerId", c.name AS "customerName" FROM wms_serial_log l JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = l.material_id JOIN wms_stock_doc d ON d.doc_no = l.doc_no JOIN scm_trade_doc t ON t.doc_no = d.source_no AND t.kind = 'SALES_OUT' JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = t.partner_id WHERE l.serial_no = #{serialNo} AND l.direction = -1 ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 1
